title: BlueCloud Launcher 0.8.0 — Office suite expansion
notes: Canvas Cloud joins Doc Cloud, Sheet Cloud and Slide Cloud in the launcher. Updated app systems and squircle logos, document mail merge and layouts, spreadsheet charts/pivots/Goal Seek, presentation tables/charts/effects, and a local whiteboard with SVG/PNG exports. Free Windows alpha apps with verified downloads. Existing libraries and update recovery are preserved; Office compatibility and collaboration remain limited.
